description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Loan' class in the Fineract project, specifically testing behaviors related to charges, transactions, and transaction sorting within the loan domain.

classes.name: LoanTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the Loan class, testing charges, transactions, and transaction sort order.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test execution.

methods.name: testGetChargesWithCharges
methods.description: Verifies that getCharges() returns a collection containing the correct charges when charges are set.

methods.name: testGetChargesWithNoCharges
methods.description: Checks that getCharges() returns an empty collection when no charges are associated.

methods.name: testGetChargesWithNull
methods.description: Ensures getCharges() handles null charges gracefully, returning an empty collection.

methods.name: testFindChargedOffTransactionEmptyList
methods.description: Verifies that findChargedOffTransaction() returns null when no transactions exist.

methods.name: testFindChargedOffTransactionNoChargeOffTransaction
methods.description: Checks that findChargedOffTransaction() returns null when there is no charge-off transaction.

methods.name: testFindChargedOffTransactionWithChargeOffTransaction
methods.description: Ensures findChargedOffTransaction() correctly finds a charge-off transaction among multiple transactions.

methods.name: testFindChargedOffTransactionWithReversedChargeOffTransaction
methods.description: Verifies that reversed charge-off transactions are ignored when searching for charge-offs.

methods.name: testGetLastUserTransactionEmptyList
methods.description: Checks that getLastUserTransaction() returns null when no transactions are present.

methods.name: testGetLastUserTransaction
methods.description: Tests that getLastUserTransaction() finds the latest non-reversed, non-accrual transaction.

methods.name: testTransactionComparator
methods.description: Verifies the custom sorting order of LoanTransaction objects based on transaction date and creation date.

methods.name: buildLoanCharge
methods.description: Helper method to create and initialize a LoanCharge object for testing purposes.
